This module finds recruiter contacts for each job.

nodes.name: Read Jobs Needing Contacts
nodes.notes:
📊 READ JOBS FROM SHEET

⚠️ SETUP REQUIRED:

1. Google Sheets credential
2. Sheet ID
3. Sheet: 'Jobs'
4. Filter: status IN ('Discovered', 'Resume Sent')

PURPOSE: Read jobs that need contact enrichment

LIMIT: Process 10-20 jobs per run to respect Apollo.io free tier (50 credits/month)

FILTER LOGIC:
- Jobs without contacts yet
- Status = Discovered or Resume Sent

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Same Sheet config as Module 4

nodes.name: Limit to 10 Jobs
nodes.notes:
🔢 LIMIT & FILTER

PURPOSE: Respect Apollo.io free tier limits

FREE TIER: 50 credits/month
- 1 contact search = 1 credit
- 10 jobs/day = 300/month (would exceed)
- So we limit to 10 jobs per run

FILTER LOGIC:
- Skip jobs already processed
- Check Notes field for 'Contact search completed'

TO ADJUST:
- Change .slice(0, 10) to .slice(0, 20)
- But monitor Apollo credits carefully!

WHAT TO SET:
✅ Nothing! Auto-limits.

nodes.name: Search Apollo.io for Contacts
nodes.notes:
🔍 APOLLO.IO CONTACT SEARCH

⚠️ CRITICAL SETUP:

1. Sign up at: https://app.apollo.io
2. Go to Settings → API → Get API Key
3. Paste API key in 'api_key' query parameter

API ENDPOINT:
https://api.apollo.io/v1/mixed_people/search

QUERY PARAMETERS:
- organization_name: Company from job posting
- person_titles: Recruiter, Talent Acquisition, HR
- per_page: 5 (get top 5 contacts)

FREE TIER:
- 50 credits/month
- 1 search = 1 credit
- Resets monthly

RESPONSE:
- Array of people with:
  - name
  - title
  - email (if available)
  - linkedin_url
  - phone (rarely available)

ERROR HANDLING:
- 401: Invalid API key
- 429: Rate limit exceeded
- 404: Company not found

FALLBACK:
- If no results, we'll flag for manual search
